title: What the Square on Your Toothpaste Really Means
description:
That coloured square isn't an ingredient code. It's an eye mark: a light sensor on the filling line spots it so the machine knows where to crimp and seal the tube. The ingredients are printed on the box.
Sources: https://www.colgate.com/en-us/oral-health/selecting-dental-products/what-is-a-toothpaste-color-code · https://www.mentalfloss.com/article/630094/what-the-color-codes-on-toothpaste-tubes-mean
